Only after you start, PocketMind sends a reduced-size image of its own app window and accepts taps, swipes, and text inside PocketMind. Chat requests can use PocketMind\'s normal features, including alarms, volume, flashlight, and launching apps. These actions can affect your device. When another app comes to the foreground, sharing pauses, the viewer is blanked, and remote controls are blocked until PocketMind returns; any action result appears in PocketMind chat. Stop blocks not-yet-run actions from this session. Screen lock or Stop ends the session. A visible banner and notification stay active. The relay operator can see the live PocketMind window and send in-app requests; use only a relay you trust. No other app\'s screen is captured or controlled.
Enter the root HTTPS address of a trusted PocketMind relay. The app requires a valid HTTPS/WSS connection and connects only after you explicitly start a session.
